newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian 35-day T-bonds sell at 6.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian 35-day T-bonds sell at 6.25 pct.

text.p: Nigeria's Central Bank said on Friday it sold 1.2 million naira worth of 35-day treasury bonds at a weighted average rate of 8.5 percent.
Bids totalled 16.3 million naira and the true yield will be 7.75 percent.
Last week's sales were 8.1 million naira worth of 10-day treasury bonds at a weighted average rate of 6.25 percent.
The central bank also said that on the primary market, 91-day treasury bills worth 4.62 million naira were sold at a marginal rate of eight percent and true yield of 8.2 percent.
It said the bids were worth 5.92 million.
